events.title: 🎉 There are already 1,000 wishlists for Knight's Party! ⚔️
events.summary: Hi there, knights! 👋 We appreciate everyone who shared Knight's Party with friends, played the demo, and added it to their wishlist! Our little staff greatly appreciates your support. 🏰 We're still working on upgrades and new minigames. Check out the demo and share your thoughts with us! Put Knight's Party on your wishlist, get your pals together, and enter the arena! ⚔️The Compact Core Games Team

events.title: Knight’s Party Joins Steam Next Fest! 🏰⚔️
events.summary: Bring your pals together. Accept the chaos. Grab the crown!Knight's Party is participating in Steam Next Fest! Grab your fellow knights and dive into the medieval chaos our demo is currently online!⚔️ Compete in ridiculous, physics-driven minigames.🎮 Challenge your friends online or share the fun with split-screen local multiplayer.👑 Survive the chaos and fight for the tournament crown!Play the demo, share your feedback, and add the game to your wishlist!

events.title: Devlog - What's Inside KNIGHT'S PARTY?
events.summary: Hello, knights 👋Here's a real look at what you're receiving when you visit Knight's Party, since we've been working on the forge for months.In simply, it's a physics driven medieval party game in which two to four knights fight in a tournament of absurd minigames. Limbs dangle, bones shatter, and the winner is the one who best accepts the mayhem.🎮 Have Fun!One computer, one keyboard, and a stack of controllers make up a couch cooperative with split screen.
